SEC / 02

The System Behind the Name

"A systematic approach to Life Safety" is a documented chain of custody from submittal to certificate of occupancy.

STEP 1

Submittals

UL system selection and engineering judgments matched to every condition in your drawings.

STEP 2

Install to Listing

Trained crews install to the tested system — no field improvisation, no unlisted details.

STEP 3

Label in the Field

Every penetration and joint labeled at the point of work with system and installer ID.

STEP 4

Photo Log

Time-stamped photo documentation tied to floor plans as the work goes in.

STEP 5

Inspection-Ready Closeout

A complete documentation package your AHJ and owner can audit — years later.

Why it matters: documentation turns a firestop line item into a defensible life-safety record. Most contractors caulk and leave. We hand over proof.

SERVICES

Scope of Work, In Detail

Firestopping and fireproofing are different trades that share one purpose: keeping a fire where it started. FFS self-performs both, to the listed system, with documentation included.

07 81 16FFS jobsite — SFRM on deck & beams
DIV 07 81 00 · STRUCTURAL

Spray-Applied Fireproofing

Protecting the structural steel — beams, bar joists, columns, and decks — so the frame keeps its strength long enough for everyone to get out and crews to get in.

  • Cementitious SFRM (07 81 16) — gypsum and portland-based, concealed & exposed
  • Intumescent coatings (07 81 23) — paint-like finish for exposed architectural steel
  • Thickness verification & bond testing per bay, reported
Quote a fireproofing scope
07 84 13FFS jobsite — labeled through-penetrations
DIV 07 84 13 · FIRESTOP

Penetration Firestopping

Every duct, conduit, pipe, and cable tray that passes through a rated assembly is a hole in your fire rating until it's sealed to a tested system.

  • Through-penetrations sealed per UL-listed systems
  • Field labels with system number + installer ID at every opening
  • Engineering judgments coordinated where no listing fits
Quote a firestop scope
07 84 46FFS jobsite — rated joints, CMU shaft
DIV 07 84 46 + 07 95 13 · FIRESTOP

Joint Firestopping & Rated Expansion Joints

Linear gaps move — head-of-wall, bottom-of-wall, wall-to-wall, and expansion joints all need systems rated for movement, smoke, and fire.

  • Head-of-wall & bottom-of-wall joints with movement capability
  • Perimeter fire containment at curtain wall edges
  • Fire-rated expansion joint assemblies (07 95 13)
Quote a joint scope
EVERY SYSTEM · DOCUMENTED

Submittals & Engineering Support

Before a tube of sealant is opened, every condition in your drawings gets matched to a tested UL system — or an engineering judgment where no listing exists.

  • UL system selection per condition, compiled into submittal packages
  • Coordination with your AHJ and special inspector
  • Closeout binder: systems, labels, photo log, floor-plan keys

BARRIER MGMT

Fire Barriers Don't Manage Themselves

A rated wall is only compliant until the next cable pull. FFS barrier management keeps operating facilities — hospitals, campuses, data centers — inspection-ready year round.

  • Above-ceiling surveys with photo-documented deficiency reports
  • Locator maps — every penetration gets a unique ID on a floor plan
  • Remediation installed to listed systems, in occupied space
  • HEPA containment & infection-control protocols for healthcare
  • Annual re-inspection cycles for Joint Commission & AHJ readiness

ABOUT

Two Decades of Sealed Buildings

Florida Firestop Systems is a Winter Park life-safety contractor — woman-owned, UL Qualified, and self-performing since 2005.

  1. 2005

    Founded in Winter Park, FL as a specialty firestopping contractor.

  2. GROWTH

    Scope expands to spray-applied fireproofing — cementitious and intumescent — across Central Florida.

  3. ACCREDITED

    UL Qualified Firestop Contractor Program; FCIA membership; WBE certification.

  4. TODAY

    Self-perform crews on healthcare, education, commercial, and industrial projects statewide.
